question: Does widening the lawful cp1792 development tape with seven frozen source-side approximation-quality observables move the 3.233e-8 observer plateau, testing information supply rather than a fourth operator class?
hypothesis: M/N/P closed three materially different operator classes on the fixed 20-channel tape within 0.11% of J while teacher forcing reaches 8.207963477637236e-9, so the binding constraint is the recorded information, not the function class. The seven aug channels expose exactly what the sealed tape discards: the pushed discarded CP3 components at each cap event (signed and absolute), the tenth correlation power's row coupling, and correlation-graph row structure at the coincident bonds where closure fails.

authority.generation_stage: public_aug7_source_observable_tape_v1 (parity-proven additive observation over the sealed v3 rollout)

single_variable_law: The arm is the frozen P2R0F2J architecture, loss, optimizer, exposure schedule, six epochs, batch size, fold law, shuffle law, and fixed final checkpoint with exactly one change: the per-unit local input widens from 20 to 27 raw channels (36 to 43 cell inputs). Nothing else moves, so any OOF shift is attributable to the added information.

scope.fold_rule: blake2s digest-size-4 little-endian of ascii '1753358438:mlp_id' modulo 4; identical to D/H/I/J/K/M/N/P
scope.no_inner_stacking_needed: This model is the base observer trained directly on host error, exactly like J; the inner-stacking firewall applies only to riders trained on a frozen model's residual.

architecture.name: aug7-widened four-channel transport-energy coherence observer
architecture.raw_composition: channels 0..19 = sealed v3 cp1792 raw locals (parity-bound); channels 20..26 = aug7 store channels in preregistered order
architecture.standardization: channel 0 (depth) unstandardized; channels 1..26 standardized by train-fold centers/scales clamped to [-8,8]; the aug7 per-row sufficient statistics are computed by streaming the aug store once and slicing the training split, exactly mirroring the sealed 19-channel convention
architecture.message_energy_coherence: identical to J: m = Phi*(s@W), e = Phi^2*(s^2@W^2), k = clamp(m/sqrt(e+1e-4*R^2),-8,8)

training.shuffle_seed: numpy default_rng(1753358438 XOR (fold * 0x9E3779B1)), J's exact law
training.loss: Exactly J's fit-fold-normalized corrected-layer rollout with layer weights linspace(0.5,1.5,14) plus equal final focus, 2e-5 normalized auxiliary-state penalty, 5e-4 near-identity transport/mixing penalty
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 6 in every fold; no checkpoint selection

decision_gate.pass: All conjuncts pass; then only the separately preregistered NATIVE augmentation stage (instrumented Q24 estimator exporting the native-instance observables, ~6.1-hour 688-row retape) may proceed under its own seal, audit, and gates.
decision_gate.fail: Close this exact aug7-widened spelling measured; no channel-subset sweep, no retune, no second checkpoint, no meter, no deployment. Produce a read-only Q-vs-J decomposition quantifying the information-supply shift and update graph.json, problem-graph.html, and problem-graph.md.

capacity_only_firewall.native_analog_map: PREREGISTRATION.json of the generation stage records the per-channel native analogs (CP4 dropped planes at _cp4_reset:969-973, cubic/quartic stars, t=24 Mehler slice, native correlation graph) and the fact that CP3 never truncates natively; channels 20-21 test the discarded-higher-order-mass mechanism whose native instance is CP4/star-based, so a pass licenses only the native stage, never deployment.

launch_gate.order: generation stage complete with 688/688 parity and a generation receipt -> this preregistration -> run manifest -> program -> static synthetic check -> independent adversarial audit receipt -> seal -> sealed smoke (no truth metrics) -> training release -> folds -> aggregate -> independent verification -> decomposition -> graph update
